title: Hardening Cross Project Isolation And PR Readiness
project: DCP Secure MCP Read-Only Evidence Facade
objective: Harden the full facade with cross-project isolation tests, injection/redaction tests, stale-proof checks, denylist regression tests, no-write evidence, embedded audit, and PR readiness artifacts.
why_this_packet_exists_now: This is the final acceptance slice. No shiny new features, just lock the vault and try to break the hinges.

execution.embedded_auditor_default: AGY/Sonnet; fallback Claude Code Sonnet; fallback Opus/Gemini for contradiction hunt

in: Add property/fixture tests for multi-project isolation.
Run full facade test suite and compile.
out: No new user-facing tools unless required to expose health/readiness.
No generic search/fetch unless explicitly approved by supervisor.

invariants: All untrusted retrieved content is marked untrusted.
PR proof is current to head SHA.
forbidden_files: src/** outside services/dcp-readonly-facade if service is not under src
plan: Review all previous packet outputs and unresolved risks.
Add multi-project fixture set with enabled, disabled, missing, dirty, stale-proof, and symlink cases.
Add tests for unknown project, disabled project, raw path, symlink escape, cross-project proof fetch, cross-project backend mismatch.
Add tests for stale proof and dirty worktree warnings.
Add tests for redaction across proof/code/memory-like payloads.
Add tests for prompt injection wrapping.
Add tests denying dopecon-bridge, mutating routes, arbitrary URLs, arbitrary ports, arbitrary backend routes.
Add no-write static grep/script check if not already present.
Run full tests, compile, secret scan, forbidden route scan.
Prepare PR handoff/readiness artifact if PR is opened.
Run embedded audit and apply fixes if in scope.
validation_gates: No forbidden mutating route is callable.
Stale proof and dirty state warnings tested.
Embedded audit PASS or PASS_WITH_RISKS with non-blocking risks.
Proof is current to final head SHA.
acceptance_criteria: PR can be opened or marked merge-ready after PR Steward review.
rollback_steps: Revert hardening changes from this packet.
If tests reveal architectural weakness, stop and create follow-up design packet.
Do not weaken denylist to pass tests.
stop_conditions: Any test requires weakening a denylist.
A stale-proof condition cannot be detected.
Embedded auditor returns FAIL or NEEDS_SUPERVISOR.

auditor_focus: Try prompt injection through returned content.
Try secret leakage through proof/code/memory payloads.
Verify final proof is not stale.
